scope: All30 original T08 supplemental criteria, their30 transfers and LSYS-EXEC-T08; historical snapshots retained.

criteria.task: Compile a uint32_t array sum over {1,0xFFFFFFFF,3} with a uint64_t accumulator. Annotate each load, extension, addition, branch and return in the actual disassembly; predict 4294967299 without executing an overflow-invalid signed substitute.

ordinary_observation.claim: Zero-extended loads produce4294967299; each build retains its actual disassembly

transfer_observation.claim: Narrow accumulator produces modulo3

criteria.task: For struct Cell {uint32_t x; uint16_t y;} under a measured sizeof/offsetof manifest, derive the effective address of cells[3].y from a synthetic base 0x1000; reconcile scale and displacement with disassembly.

ordinary_observation.claim: Measured Cell stride8 and y offset4 derive synthetic address0x101c without dereferencing it

transfer_observation.claim: Packed and reordered field manifests change offsets and stride

criteria.task: Decode the supplied B8 78 56 34 12 vector in declared 64-bit mode with 32-bit operand width, then list what its ISA meaning does and does not establish about latency, throughput or cache effects.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual x86 MOV encoding decoded under explicit operand width

transfer_observation.claim: Two equal instruction-count IMUL loops vary dependency graph;18 paired samples/compiler, independent modular oracle; no fixed latency conclusion

criteria.task: Draw before/after state for one integer comparison and one floating-point computation in your disassembly, including general registers, stack pointer and relevant flag/control state. Mark unspecified call-boundary values.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual MXCSR before/after scalar FP computation; controls preserved and local original state restored

transfer_observation.claim: External clobber demonstrates flags are not call-preserved; save/recompute live values under declared ABI

criteria.task: Extend the existing hostile caller to vary all callee-preserved sentinels independently; compare a correct sum routine with a version corrupting RBX while returning the correct result.

ordinary_observation.claim: Six independently varied callee-preserved register sentinels; arithmetic-correct corruption rejected

transfer_observation.claim: Actual nested call clobbers scratch argument registers; input lifetime preserved

criteria.task: Trace an x86 comparison of bit patterns 0xFFFFFFFF and 1 as signed32 and unsigned32, identifying branch conditions and flags from subtraction. Supply a separate portable C expression for each interpretation.

ordinary_observation.claim: Five subtraction cases independently check CF/ZF/SF/OF and signed versus unsigned predicates

transfer_observation.claim: 0-1 sets carry without signed overflow; INT_MIN-1 sets signed overflow without carry

criteria.task: For a bounded uint32_t x*8 routine retain source, compiler IR and disassembly, then map the value computation across representations. Use inputs0,1,UINT32_MAX with modulo arithmetic.

ordinary_observation.claim: Unsigned multiplication0/1/UINT_MAX agrees with independent64-bit modulo oracle; LLVM IR and object retained

transfer_observation.claim: Signed range is ceil(INT_MIN/8)..floor(INT_MAX/8); no overflowing evaluation

criteria.task: Create two equivalent bounded sums: one eligible for inlining and one crossing a separate TU boundary. Inspect branch removal and register spills while retaining identical outputs and measured code sizes.

ordinary_observation.claim: Equal bounded separate-TU/local computations, sizes and paired elapsed samples retained

transfer_observation.claim: GCC/Clang actual LTO linker runs, with full disassembly and no promised speedup

criteria.task: Analyze int f(int x){return x+1>x;} at INT_MAX without running it as a defined test; compare with unsigned and checked-add implementations. Distinguish optimizer reasoning from observed wraparound.

ordinary_observation.claim: INT_MAX ISO signed case is analysis-only; checked failure leaves output77 and unsigned wrap comparison false

transfer_observation.claim: GCC and Clang documented -fwrapv mode executes separate signed-wrap contract

criteria.task: Annotate caller and callee of existing mi_mix for eight uint64_t arguments, including seventh/eighth locations before and after call. Independently derive outputs for (1..8) and the high-bit boundary case.

ordinary_observation.claim: Eight arguments recorded before/after call and weighted sum204

transfer_observation.claim: Ninth integer plus separate double argument class executes

criteria.task: Compile three return types: uint64_t, struct {uint64_t a,b;}, and struct {uint64_t a,b,c;}. Derive classification and hidden-result ownership, then verify call-site and callee agree without casting incompatible function pointers.

ordinary_observation.claim: Scalar, integer pair and hidden-result triple execute through compatible prototypes

transfer_observation.claim: Mixed integer/SSE return executes with distinct register classes

criteria.task: Instrument an original assembly call boundary to record rsp modulo16 before call and at callee entry, including two stack arguments. Verify allocated argument space and cleanup across repeated calls.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual baseline pre-call0 and entry8 modulo16 observed repeatedly

transfer_observation.claim: Ninth AVX register-sized argument spills with actual compiler32-byte alignment; compile-only AVX fixture

criteria.task: Compile an address-taken local array and a non-address-taken scalar at O0/O2; annotate frame setup, spills, saved registers and red-zone use. Reconcile every stack adjustment with an observed object or ABI obligation.

ordinary_observation.claim: O0/O2 source/object/stack manifests distinguish address-escaped array from scalar

transfer_observation.claim: Value live across external call has recorded save/spill choices

criteria.task: Compare recursive and iterative unsigned factorial for inputs0..12 with and without sibling-call optimization and frame pointers. Derive logical activation count separately from actual frame growth.

ordinary_observation.claim: Recursive/tail/iterative factorial0..12 matches independently listed13 results across four profiles

transfer_observation.claim: Post-call volatile count equalsn and blocks tail-position claim; no ISO tail-call guarantee

criteria.task: Build a leaf routine with a64-byte temporary under ordinary userspace and -mno-red-zone; inspect addressing. Explain why kernel/interrupt contexts need a separately established environment contract.

ordinary_observation.claim: 64-byte volatile leaf inspected with/without red zone

transfer_observation.claim: External-call variant keeps live temporary under actual frame allocation

criteria.task: Create sizeof/_Alignof/offsetof manifests for int,long,void*,size_t under LP64 and any available ILP32 target. Classify unavailable builds explicitly and analyze serialization of long as a proposed wire format.

ordinary_observation.claim: LP64 executable manifest and actual ILP32 object manifest

transfer_observation.claim: Actual LLVM COFF LLP64 object manifest; no Windows execution claim

criteria.task: Measure struct {char a; uint32_t b; uint16_t c;} and an explicitly packed extension variant; explain internal/tail padding and alignment. Compare member values, never use raw padding bytes as semantic equality.

ordinary_observation.claim: Ordinary offsets0/4/8,size12 versus packed0/1/5,size7

transfer_observation.claim: Reordered size8 changes binary interface despite same member values

criteria.task: Compile producer/consumer manifests separately with intentionally different public layout macros. Check widths, offsets, alignment and interface version before linking/execution; retain the rejected pair.

ordinary_observation.claim: Separately compiled same-symbol manifests reject changed public layout before unsafe linking/access

transfer_observation.claim: Opaque handle implementation and separately compiled client execute with hidden private layout

criteria.task: Compile float add for Arm32 soft and softfp with the same base procedure-call convention; inspect instructions and argument locations, keeping results compile-only unless a supported target exists.

ordinary_observation.claim: Soft add object has explicit forbidden-for-final-image __aeabi_fadd; softfp emits VADD but base PCS

transfer_observation.claim: Hard/softfp VFP instruction selection compared with differing register argument attributes
limitations: QEMU architectural execution and semihosting only; no physical FPU timing, electrical or peripheral evidence.

criteria.task: Prepare an Arm32 object compatibility matrix for soft, softfp and hard-float, including target attributes and linker diagnostics. Require a known-good same-profile link control.

ordinary_observation.claim: All nine soft/softfp/hard caller/callee links run with same-profile success controls

transfer_observation.claim: Variadic double marshaling object retained under all profiles; no variadic numeric execution claimed
limitations: QEMU architectural execution and semihosting only; no physical FPU timing, electrical or peripheral evidence.

criteria.task: List preserved VFP registers from the inspected AAPCS32 passage, then inspect a small assembly callee using d8 and a caller-owned sentinel design. Do not claim x86 hostile tests validate Arm preservation.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual M4 guest preserves d8 across32 independent sentinel values; mutant returns correct float but fails preservation

transfer_observation.claim: Assembler rejects absent d16 on SP-D16; d8-d15 obligation is unchanged; actual two PCS guest profiles
limitations: QEMU architectural execution and semihosting only; no physical FPU timing, electrical or peripheral evidence.

criteria.task: Implement the existing mi_asm_sum contract with explicit text/function/global declarations, unsigned loads, zero-count no-access and a nonexecutable stack note. Inspect symbol type, size and stack permissions.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual baseline assembly exported in shared object with FUNC and nonexecutable stack

transfer_observation.claim: Dynamic symbol boundary and local labels inspected

criteria.task: Add matching CFI to an original assembly routine with a saved register and stack adjustment; inspect unwind tables and capture a debugger backtrace from a nested call. Corrupt only the CFI in a separate analysis variant.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual saved-RBX/32-byte frame CFI and debugger backtrace

transfer_observation.claim: No frame pointer; early-return state restored; wrong metadata has CFA40 rather than48

criteria.task: Extend the hostile harness with zero count/null, singleton UINT32_MAX, repeated calls and an alignment recorder. Demonstrate two mutants: preserved-register corruption and wrong stack adjustment, using bounded original processes.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual hostile/null/singleton/repeated alignment controls in core

transfer_observation.claim: Separately compiled optimized C pressure consumer executes129 surrounding-value cases per compiler

criteria.task: Specify a two-instruction unsigned add inline assembly block with one read/write operand and one scratch output written before all inputs are consumed. Explain tied and early-clobber constraints, then inspect register allocation at O0/O2.

ordinary_observation.claim: Two-instruction read-write plus early-clobber constraints execute O0/O2 and sanitizer profiles

transfer_observation.claim: Equal-value loop plus explicit invalid alias allocation demonstrates missing-constraint counterexample

criteria.task: Compare an asm block that accesses a named memory operand with one accessing memory through an opaque pointer plus memory clobber. Explain which values the compiler may retain across each; no concurrent data race is executed.

ordinary_observation.claim: Named +m and opaque-pointer memory-clobber both execute with ownership contract

transfer_observation.claim: Precise named-memory alternative retains explicit cc effect; broad clobber is not synchronization

criteria.task: For an empty asm memory clobber, inspect the final instructions and compare with an explicitly selected processor fence. Separate compile ordering, CPU ordering and ISO C atomic synchronization in a three-layer table.

ordinary_observation.claim: Empty compiler barrier, emitted mfence and release atomic have distinct contracts

transfer_observation.claim: Actual Cortex-M4 DMB object; Arm ordering argument remains separate from C synchronization

criteria.task: Compare a normal call, userspace getpid syscall, synchronous fault and external interrupt in a saved-state/return-owner table. Use only a harmless local syscall for execution; exception cases remain documented analysis.

ordinary_observation.claim: Normal call and harmless direct Linux getpid syscall execute; saved-state table separates faults and interrupts

transfer_observation.claim: Signal frame and async-signal-safe obligations analyzed separately; no signal or interrupt execution claimed

criteria.task: Classify user-legal arithmetic/syscall and privileged control-register or interrupt-control instructions for the selected ISA. Inspect bytes only for privileged examples, with an explicit do-not-execute marker.

ordinary_observation.claim: Privileged control-register/CLI/STI specimen assembled and decoded only; never linked/executed

transfer_observation.claim: Complete disposable guest protocol specifies privilege/IDT/page-table/capture prerequisites; analysis-only by original task

criteria.task: Draw the distinction between architectural fault PC/register state, OS signal delivery and C setjmp/longjmp control state. Explain why arbitrary saved machine bits cannot be cast into a portable C continuation.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual same-thread live-frame setjmp/longjmp7 and explicit indeterminate-local rule

transfer_observation.claim: Cooperative suspension versus asynchronous preemption analyzed with ownership/reentrancy counterexample
